title: Learning representations by back-propagating errors
summary: David E. Rumelhart, Geoffrey E. Hinton and Ronald J. Williams published Learning representations by back-propagating errors in Nature on 9 October 1986, describing a learning procedure that repeatedly adjusts connection weights in networks of neuron-like units to reduce the difference between actual and desired outputs.
significance: A documented major milestone in the historical development and dissemination of back-propagation for training multilayer neural networks.

verification.note: Title, authors, publication date, volume, pages, DOI and the paper's description of its learning procedure are verified against Nature's record for the original article. This record does not claim that the authors were the first people ever to formulate back-propagation.
